correctness.rationale: For arbitrary equivalences δ and γ, each surjective two-valued map to a pair in a single γ-class and constant on δ-classes preserves θ if θ≤δ or θ≥γ. Conversely, if θ is in neither interval, choose θ-related x,y in different δ-blocks and γ-related p,q distinguished by θ, and define the two-valued map by δ-blocks to separate x,y. This proves the complete congruence lattice is [0,δ]∪[γ,1] even at degenerate endpoints. For m≥4 choose δ with {0,1},{2,3} as only nonsingleton blocks, γ with U={0,2,4,...,m−1} and V={1,3}. The two intervals have respectively four and two members; their meets/joins show exactly the specified six-element nondistributive H. Congruence-lattice chain of length three entails m−1≥3, so m≥4 sharp. Independent literal enumeration of family operations and all equivalence relations for m=4,5 produced six congruences and checked the stated operation counts; general proof independent of these experiments.
